name: ssbssa/heob
purpose: Detect heap buffer overruns and leaks in native Windows applications | Tool; MSVC and MinGW builds; PDB uses DbgHelp and DWARF can use dwarfstack

name: jrfonseca/drmingw
purpose: Capture unhandled exceptions and symbolize MinGW or MSVC stacks | Debugger and embeddable symbol/backtrace DLLs; supports DWARF and PDB

name: ssbssa/dwarfstack
purpose: Resolve MinGW executable addresses to source files and lines | Native Windows library focused on GCC DWARF information; stack completeness depends on compiler options

name: VerySleepy/verysleepy
purpose: Sample CPU usage in Windows applications with symbol resolution | GUI and command-line profiler; evaluate current compiler and Windows compatibility
